newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa mulls $1.5 bln syndicated loan - report.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa mulls $1.5 bln syndicated loan - report.

text.p: South Africa is considering putting in place a $1.5 billion syndicated loan facility for three years to draw down at times when there is pressure on the foreign exchnage reserves, Business Day newspaper said on Friday, quoting foreign banking sources.
Reserve Bank deputy governor James Cross said the central bank would always investigate various methods of financing in the market and a syndicted loan was one possibility.

"No decisions have been taken and any reports on a syndicated loan facility are highly speculative at this stage. The Bank is not seeking new finance of any magnitude at this time," he told the paper.

The trade journal International Financial Review referred to the Bank's discussions with foreign bankers in its latest issue, saying there were rumours that South Africa was on the verge of coming to market with a jumbo syndicated deal.
